newsitem.title: USA: HL&P 1,250 MW nuke down for scheduled work.
newsitem.headline: HL&P 1,250 MW nuke down for scheduled work.

text.p: Houston Lighting & Power Co's (HL&P) 1,250 megawatt South Texas nuclear power unit 2 was shut over the weekend for scheduled maintenance and refueling, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The unit was taken off line Saturday, and was in a cold shutdown mode as of early Monday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
An NRC official has said HL&P has scheduled a 35-day outage for South Texas 2.
HL&P has a company policy not to comment on the operating status of its nuclear power plants.
The 1,250 megawatt South Texas nuclear power unit 1, also located at Palacios, Texas, was operating normally at 100 percent of capacity as of early Monday, the NRC said.
HL&P is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
